commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
90+9' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+8' Las Palmas quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+7' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90+6' Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a great save to block a header from Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) after a nice lofted cross.
90+5' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) but poses no threat.
90+4' One of the Las Palmas players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.

90+2' What a big chance! Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
90+2' Fran Perez (Valencia) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' Marvin (Las Palmas) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Las Palmas force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.

89' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
87' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.
